scenario.topic: Decide on a format for the weekly team meeting
scenario.opening_question: What balance between meeting length and team engagement works best for us?

options.name: Structured Round-Robin Updates Format
options.upside: Ensures equal participation and clear progress tracking
options.tradeoff: Can feel rigid and limit spontaneous discussion
options.concern: May reduce flexibility to address urgent topics
options.best_for: teams valuing fairness and thorough status updates

options.name: Casual Open Discussion with Agenda Flexibility
options.concern: May lead to uneven participation among members
options.best_for: teams prioritizing flexibility and spontaneous collaboration

options.name: Focused Sprint Review with Pre-Submitted Reports
options.upside: Shorter meetings with focused discussion on key issues
options.tradeoff: Requires significant upfront preparation from all members
options.concern: May exclude real-time updates or emergent topics
options.best_for: teams aiming for efficiency and well-prepared input

options.name: Rotating Facilitator with Themed Weekly Focus
options.upside: Builds leadership skills and keeps meetings fresh
options.tradeoff: Inconsistent meeting quality depending on facilitator skill
options.concern: Some members may feel unprepared or uncomfortable leading
options.best_for: teams wanting engagement and varied perspectives

shared_context: Weekly meetings are scheduled for 1 hour on Wednesdays at 10 AM
The goal is to maximize productivity while keeping everyone engaged
